french: Si Dell te demande de lui offrir un café, tu refuses. J'ai vu les conséquences la dernière fois... et tu ne veux pas connaître ça.

bulgarian: If Dell asks you to buy her coffee, do NOT. I saw what happened last time... and no, you do NOT want to know.

english: Darcy makes the BEST =Hot Chocolate=! She drew me a crown in the foam this time!
french: Darcy prépare le meilleur =chocolat chaud= au monde ! Une fois, elle m'a même fait une couronne dans la mousse !
russian: Дарси делает ЛУЧШИЙ =горячий шоколад=! В этот раз она нарисовала мне корону в пенке!
bulgarian: Darcy makes the BEST =Hot Chocolate=! She drew me a crown in the foam this time!

english: Darcy's been making rose hot chocolate recently... it tastes so fancy, I feel like a princess.
french: Darcy propose du chocolat chaud à la rose ces derniers temps... C'est si raffiné que j'ai l'impression d'être une princesse quand j'en bois.
russian: Дарси недавно начала делать розовый горячий шоколад... на вкус такой утончённый, я прямо чувствую себя принцессой!
bulgarian: Darcy's been making rose hot chocolate recently... it tastes so fancy, I feel like a princess.

english: I could have =Hot Chocolate= every day of the year... yum!
french: Si je m'écoutais, je boirais du =chocolat chaud= tous les jours... Miam !
russian: Я бы пила =горячий шоколад= каждый день в году... ням!
bulgarian: I could have =Hot Chocolate= every day of the year... yum!

english: I only want to see the most princessy clothes that Mister Louis has!
french: Chez monsieur Louis, je ne regarde que les habits qui donnent l'air d'une princesse !
russian: Я хочу видеть ТОЛЬКО самую принцессную одежду, что есть у мистера Луи!
bulgarian: I only want to see the most princessy clothes that Mister Louis has!

english: Lady Adeline bought that dress over there... do you think Mister Louis will make it in my size?
french: Dame Adeline a acheté cette robe... Tu crois que monsieur Louis pourrait me confectionner la même à ma taille ?
russian: Леди Аделина купила вон то платье... Как думаешь, мистер Луи сошьёт его на мой размер?
bulgarian: Lady Adeline bought that dress over there... do you think Mister Louis will make it in my size?

english: I like to look fancy... REALLY fancy... Mister Louis understands.
french: J'aime les vêtements chics... vraiment chics... Monsieur Louis le sait bien.
russian: Мне нравится выглядеть нарядно... ОЧЕНЬ нарядно... Мистер Луи это понимает.
bulgarian: I like to look fancy... REALLY fancy... Mister Louis understands.

english: I keep telling Mister Louis, more bows, MORE ribbons! I demand it! Not just for me... for everyone!
french: Je répète sans arrêt à monsieur Louis qu'il doit ajouter des nœuds et des rubans à ses créations ! Et pas que pour moi... Pour tout le monde !
russian: Я всё твержу мистеру Луи: больше бантиков, БОЛЬШЕ лент! Я приказываю! И не только для меня... для всех!
bulgarian: I keep telling Mister Louis, more bows, MORE ribbons! I demand it! Not just for me... for everyone!

english: I hope I hope I HOPE that Miss Merri has some princessy furniture! Pleaaaase!
french: J'espère tellement que mademoiselle Merri aura des meubles de princesse ! J'en rêve !
russian: Я очень-очень-ОЧЕНЬ надеюсь, что у мисс Мэрри есть мебель для принцесс! Пожа-а-а-луйста!
bulgarian: I hope I hope I HOPE that Miss Merri has some princessy furniture! Pleaaaase!

english: I want the PERFECT bed... it should have tall posts, and a big canopy, and the inside should look like stars! And... and... and...!
french: Je veux le lit parfait... À baldaquin, avec un grand ciel de lit et plein d'étoiles imprimées à l'intérieur ! Et... et... et...!
russian: Я хочу ИДЕАЛЬНУЮ кровать... с высокими столбами, с балдахином, и чтобы внутри всё напоминало звёзды! И... и... и...!
bulgarian: I want the PERFECT bed... it should have tall posts, and a big canopy, and the inside should look like stars! And... and... and...!

english: Ma loves all of Miss Merri's furniture... sometimes we end up with furniture before there's a room to put it in.
french: Maman adore les meubles de mademoiselle Merri... Des fois, elle en achète alors qu'on n'a plus de place.
russian: Мама обожает всю мебель от мисс Мэрри... иногда мы приносим мебель домой, ещё до того, как решим, куда её ставить.
bulgarian: Ma loves all of Miss Merri's furniture... sometimes we end up with furniture before there's a room to put it in.

english: Miss Merri's always getting help from Mister Hayden and Mister Olric... she knows how to delegate. I admire that.
french: Mademoiselle Merri se fait toujours aider par monsieur Hayden et monsieur Olric... Elle sait déléguer. Je trouve ça impressionnant.
russian: Мисс Мэрри знает, как получить помощь от мистера Хейдена и мистера Ольрика... она умеет делегировать. Я восхищаюсь этим!
bulgarian: Miss Merri's always getting help from Mister Hayden and Mister Olric... she knows how to delegate. I admire that.

english: I asked Mister Stillwell whether it's my destiny to be a princess and he started mumbling about the signs in the stars... what do the stars have to do with it?
bulgarian: I asked Mister Stillwell whether it's my destiny to be a princess and he started mumbling about the signs in the stars... what do the stars have to do with it?

english: Is Mister Stillwell okay? I mean in general...
bulgarian: Is Mister Stillwell okay? I mean in general...

english: When I become a princess, Mister Stillwell is going to be my royal fortune-teller... and also my royal wailer. He's really good at wailing...
bulgarian: When I become a princess, Mister Stillwell is going to be my royal fortune-teller... and also my royal wailer. He's really good at wailing...

english: You know, I think Mister Stillwell likes darkness... if he likes it so much, he should marry it.
bulgarian: You know, I think Mister Stillwell likes darkness... if he likes it so much, he should marry it.

english: I bet his mom washed his mouth out with soap.
french: Je parie que sa mère lui lavait la bouche au savon.
russian: Наверняка мама ему мыла рот с мылом.
bulgarian: I bet his mom washed his mouth out with soap.

english: A lot.
french: Très souvent.
russian: Много мыла.
bulgarian: A lot.

english: Mister Taliferro's teeth sure are shiny.
french: Monsieur Taliferro a les dents vraiment blanches.
russian: Зубы у мистера Талиферро такие блестящие.
bulgarian: Mister Taliferro's teeth sure are shiny.

english: When do I get to judge HIS cooking?
french: Quand est-ce que je pourrai noter un de ses plats à LUI ?
russian: Когда я буду оценивать ЕГО блюда?
bulgarian: When do I get to judge HIS cooking?

english: If Mister Taliferro is such a good cook, why is he asking everyone to cook for him?
french: Si monsieur Taliferro est un chef si renommé, pourquoi est-ce qu'il demande aux autres de cuisiner ?
russian: Если мистер Талиферро такой хороший повар, зачем тогда он просит всех готовить ему?
bulgarian: If Mister Taliferro is such a good cook, why is he asking everyone to cook for him?

english: But I'll make Mister Taliferro HER royal chef, and he'll have to wait on her all day long!
french: Et je ferai de monsieur Taliferro son cuisinier personnel. Comme ça, il sera à son service toute la journée !
russian: Но я сделаю мистера Талиферро ЕЁ придворным шефом, и пусть дожидается её целый день!
bulgarian: But I'll make Mister Taliferro HER royal chef, and he'll have to wait on her all day long!

english: When I'm queen, Reina will be my royal chef, obviously.
french: Quand je serai reine, Reina sera ma cuisinière attitrée.
russian: Когда я стану королевой, моим придворным шефом, разумеется, будет Рейна.
bulgarian: When I'm queen, Reina will be my royal chef, obviously.

english: Maybe when he was little, a $Cooking Challenge$ bullied him and called him names...
french: Peut-être qu'un $défi gastronomique$ l'a traumatisé quand il était petit...
russian: Может, когда он был маленький, его задирал и обзывал какой-то $смотр блюд$...
bulgarian: Maybe when he was little, a $Cooking Challenge$ bullied him and called him names...

english: Why do you think Mister Taliferro is so mean?
french: À ton avis, pourquoi monsieur Taliferro est-il aussi méchant ?
russian: Как ты думаешь, почему мистер Талиферро такой грубиян?
bulgarian: Why do you think Mister Taliferro is so mean?

english: Lady Adeline and I are going to get our hair done together someday... she promised! Yay!
french: Dame Adeline et moi, on se fera teindre les cheveux ensemble un jour... Elle me l'a promis ! Youpi !
russian: Леди Аделина и я когда-нибудь сделаем причёски вместе... она обещала! Ура!
bulgarian: Lady Adeline and I are going to get our hair done together someday... she promised! Yay!

english: I want to try dyeing my hair too! How about.... pink!
french: Moi aussi, j'ai envie de me faire teindre les cheveux ! En... rose !
russian: Я тоже хочу попробовать покрасить волосы! Например... в розовый!
bulgarian: I want to try dyeing my hair too! How about.... pink!

english: What color is the most royal color for hair? Mom says it's mine!
french: Quelle est la couleur de cheveux la plus royale ? Maman dit que c'est la mienne !
russian: Какой цвет волос самый королевский? Мама говорит, что мой!
bulgarian: What color is the most royal color for hair? Mom says it's mine!

english: What color would a queen dye her hair? No really, I need to know.
french: De quelle couleur une reine se teindrait-elle les cheveux ? C'est une question sérieuse.
russian: В какой цвет бы покрасилась королева? Нет, правда, мне нужно знать!
bulgarian: What color would a queen dye her hair? No really, I need to know.

english: Every queen needs at least one advisor who she suspects will betray her... it makes things interesting!
french: Une reine doit toujours avoir au moins un conseiller qu'elle soupçonne de la trahir. Ça pimente un peu les choses.
russian: Каждой королеве нужен хотя бы один советник, которого можно подозревать в измене... Иначе неинтересно!
bulgarian: Every queen needs at least one advisor who she suspects will betray her... it makes things interesting!

english: When I'm Queen of all Aldaria, I'll make Mister Wheedle my deceitful minister.
french: Quand je régnerai sur Aldaria, je ferai de monsieur Wheedle mon ministre perfide.
russian: Когда я стану королевой Альдарии, я сделаю мистера Хлюста своим коварным министром.
bulgarian: When I'm Queen of all Aldaria, I'll make Mister Wheedle my deceitful minister.

english: I know Wheedle's scam... Mister Balor told me all about it. That's why Wheedle banned me... coward.
bulgarian: I know Wheedle's scam... Mister Balor told me all about it. That's why Wheedle banned me... coward.

english: I think we should.
french: Je pense qu'on devrait.
russian: Мне кажется, мы просто обязаны.
bulgarian: I think we should.

english: I was looking at Mister Wheedle's suit and wondering... do you think the Dragonguard can arrest someone for fashion crimes?
french: En observant la tenue de monsieur Wheedle, je me suis demandé si la Garde des dragons pouvait arrêter quelqu'un pour crime contre le bon goût.
russian: Недавно я посмотрела на костюм мистера Хлюста и задумалась... Как ты думаешь, Драконья стража имеет право арестовать человека за преступления против хорошего вкуса?
bulgarian: I was looking at Mister Wheedle's suit and wondering... do you think the Dragonguard can arrest someone for fashion crimes?

english: He just seems like he belongs in there, you know?
french: On a l'impression que c'est là qu'est sa vraie place, non ?
russian: Ему там, кажется, будет самое место.
bulgarian: He just seems like he belongs in there, you know?

english: I didn't really believe in dungeons until I met Mister Wheedle.
french: Avant de rencontrer monsieur Wheedle, je ne croyais pas à l'utilité des prisons.
russian: Мне не очень нравилась идея темницы, пока я не встретила мистера Хлюста.
bulgarian: I didn't really believe in dungeons until I met Mister Wheedle.

english: How dare he speak to his future liege lord in such a tone!
french: Comment ose-t-il s'adresser ainsi à sa future reine ?
russian: Как он смеет так разговаривать со своим будущим сьюзереном!
bulgarian: How dare he speak to his future liege lord in such a tone!

english: We'll see who the baby is when he's crying at the bottom of my oubliette!
french: On verra qui est le bébé le jour où il pleurera au fond d'une de mes oubliettes !
russian: Посмотрим, кто будет кричать как малыш, когда я брошу его в темницу!
bulgarian: We'll see who the baby is when he's crying at the bottom of my oubliette!

english: Mister Wheedle said he doesn't sell his wares to little babies.
french: Monsieur Wheedle a dit qu'il ne vendait pas sa marchandise à des bébés.
russian: Мистер Хлюст сказал, что не продаёт свои товары малышам.
bulgarian: Mister Wheedle said he doesn't sell his wares to little babies.

english: It'll make good background music next time I'm pretending I'm the Queen!
french: Ça sera une bonne musique d'ambiance la prochaine fois que je jouerai à être reine !
russian: Включу на фоне в следующий раз, когда буду представлять себя королевой!
bulgarian: It'll make good background music next time I'm pretending I'm the Queen!

english: I asked Zorel if she could get the Aldarian National Anthem on a $Song Crystal$.
french: J'ai demandé à Zorel si elle pourrait mettre l'hymne national aldarien sur un $cristal musical$.
russian: Я попросила Зорель записать в $поющий кристалл$ национальный гимн Альдарии.
bulgarian: I asked Zorel if she could get the Aldarian National Anthem on a $Song Crystal$.

english: It's cute when a thing looks like another thing, isn't it?
french: J'adore quand quelque chose ressemble à autre chose, pas toi ?
russian: Забавно, когда какая-нибудь штука по форме похожа на что-то ещё.
bulgarian: It's cute when a thing looks like another thing, isn't it?

english: Did you donate that $Bell Berry$ at the Museum?
french: C'est toi qui as fait don de cette $clocherelle$ au musée ?
russian:
Это ты

пожертвовали

пожертвовалапожертвовалпожертвовало музею $колокольник$?
bulgarian: Did you donate that $Bell Berry$ at the Museum?

english: I don't believe him, though. He's too busy playing cards with Pa to write all that.
french: Je ne le crois pas. Il est trop occupé à jouer aux cartes avec papa pour avoir eu le temps d'écrire tout ça.
russian: Не верю. Когда бы он это всё написал, если он целыми днями с папой в карты играет?
bulgarian: I don't believe him, though. He's too busy playing cards with Pa to write all that.

english: Mister Balor said that the $Criminal Confession$ in the Museum is HIS.
french: Monsieur Balor a dit que les $aveux$ du musée étaient les siens...
russian: Мистер Балор сказал, что $повинная преступника$ в музее — ЕГО.
bulgarian: Mister Balor said that the $Criminal Confession$ in the Museum is HIS.

english: And he was right!
french: Et il avait raison !
russian: И был прав!
bulgarian: And he was right!

english: Luc was so excited to show me the $Crystal Wing Moth$ at the Museum! He said it looked just like a tiara!
french: Luc était super content de me montrer la $phalène cristalline$ au musée. Il m'avait dit qu'elle ressemblait à une tiare.
russian: Люк был так рад показать мне $кристальную бабочку$ в музее! Он сказал, она похожа на тиару!
bulgarian: Luc was so excited to show me the $Crystal Wing Moth$ at the Museum! He said it looked just like a tiara!

english: I wonder what it was used for?
french: Je me demande à quoi elle pouvait bien servir...
russian: Интересно, для чего его использовали?
bulgarian: I wonder what it was used for?

english: Scaring people, I bet!
french: À part à faire peur aux gens !
russian: Наверное, чтобы людей пугать!
bulgarian: Scaring people, I bet!

english: That $Fossilized Mandrake Root$ sure is unsettling to look at.
french: Cette $racine de mandragore fossilisée$ me donne la chair de poule.
russian: Меня немного пугает $окаменелый корень мандрагоры$.
bulgarian: That $Fossilized Mandrake Root$ sure is unsettling to look at.

english: He also pulls his home around with him!
french: Lui aussi, il ne se déplace jamais sans sa maison !
russian: Он тоже свой дом везде с собой таскает!
bulgarian: He also pulls his home around with him!

english: Y'know, [Ari], that $Hermit Snail$ at the Museum makes me think of Mister Balor.
french: [Ari], tu sais quoi ? L'$hélix-l'ermite$ du musée me fait penser à monsieur Balor.
russian: Знаешь, [Ari], та $улитка-отшельник$ в музее напоминает мне мистера Балора.
bulgarian: Y'know, [Ari], that $Hermit Snail$ at the Museum makes me think of Mister Balor.

english: Just like a royal advisor who can't be trusted.
french: Un peu comme un conseiller royal perfide.
russian: Словно королевский советник, которому нельзя доверять.
bulgarian: Just like a royal advisor who can't be trusted.

english: The $Rainbow Geode$ at the Museum is sooo pretty! And it changes colors depending on how you look at it!
french: La $géode arc-en-ciel$ du musée est magnifique. En plus, elle change de couleur en fonction de la lumière !
russian: $Радужная жеода$ в музее такая красивая! И она меняет цвет, если посмотреть с другой стороны!
bulgarian: The $Rainbow Geode$ at the Museum is sooo pretty! And it changes colors depending on how you look at it!

english: The $Ritual Scepter$ at the Museum is so fancy! It looks like it belonged to someone super royal!
french: Le $sceptre rituel$ du musée est magnifique. Je suis sûre qu'il appartenait à un roi ou à une reine !
russian: Тот $ритуальный скипетр$ в музее такой классный! Наверное, он принадлежал кому-то очень королевскому!
bulgarian: The $Ritual Scepter$ at the Museum is so fancy! It looks like it belonged to someone super royal!

english: I like my grapes super sweet, thank you very much.
french: Ce n'est pas pour moi. Je préfère le raisin très sucré.
russian: Ну уж нет, спасибо, я люблю, когда виноград сладкий.
bulgarian: I like my grapes super sweet, thank you very much.

english: Reina says the $Sea Grapes$ at the Museum probably have a more salty taste, like the ocean.
french: Reina dit que le $raisin de mer$ exposé au musée doit avoir un goût salé, comme l'océan.
russian: Рейна говорит, что $морской виноград$ на вкус должен быть солёный, как океан.
bulgarian: Reina says the $Sea Grapes$ at the Museum probably have a more salty taste, like the ocean.

english: I have to get down to the beach soon...
french: Il faudrait que j'aille faire un tour à la plage un de ces jours...
russian: Надо бы поскорее сходить на пляж...
bulgarian: I have to get down to the beach soon...

english: The =Stone Shell= at the Museum is so pretty! Did you know, in olden times queens would blow on a shell to call their armies down on their enemies?
french: La =conque de pierre= du musée est de toute beauté ! Tu savais qu'autrefois, les reines soufflaient dans une conque pour ordonner à leurs armées de lancer l'assaut ?
russian: Та =каменная ракушка= из музея такая красивая! Знаешь, что в стародавние времена, королевы дули в ракушки, чтобы обрушить свои армии на врагов?
bulgarian: The =Stone Shell= at the Museum is so pretty! Did you know, in olden times queens would blow on a shell to call their armies down on their enemies?
